examples.en: The President reiterated his call for Congress to pass the Paycheck Fairness Act that would strengthen the Equal Pay Act and give women more tools to fight pay discrimination.
examples.zh: 總統再次呼籲國會通過《薪酬公平法案》，該法案將加強《同工同酬法案》，並為女性提供更多對抗薪資歧視的工具。

definitions_en: n. a series of actions advancing a principle or tending toward a particular end
n. several related operations aimed at achieving a particular goal (usually within geographical and temporal constraints)
n. an overland journey by hunters (especially in Africa)
v. run, stand, or compete for an office or a position
translations_zh: n. 战役, 运动, 竞选运动
vi. 参加运动, 作战

examples.en: We started a campaign against smoking.
examples.zh: 我們開始了一個反對吸煙運動。

examples.en: Lobbyists for the bill funneled bribes into a campaign fund.
examples.zh: 該法案的說客把遊說賄款匯入了競選基金。

definitions_en: n. the tangible substance that goes into the makeup of a physical object
n. information (data or ideas or observations) that can be used or reworked into a finished form
n. things needed for doing or making something
n. a person judged suitable for admission or employment
translations_zh: n. 材料, 物资, 素材, 布料, 资料
a. 物质的, 肉体的, 重要的

examples.en: Food and drink are material needs.
examples.zh: 食物和饮料是物质需求。

examples.en: She is collecting material for a book.
examples.zh: 她为一本书收集材料。

definitions_en: n. the people who inhabit a territory or state
n. a group of organisms of the same species inhabiting a given area
n. (statistics) the entire aggregation of items from which samples can be drawn
n. the number of inhabitants (either the total number or the number of a particular race or class) in a given place (country or city etc.)
translations_zh: n. 人口, 人口数
[化] 群体; 总体

examples.en: By the year 2020, the population of our city will have doubled.
examples.zh: 在2020年以前，我們的城市的人口將增加一倍。

examples.en: We debated on the question of world population.
examples.zh: 我們在世界人口問題上爭辯了一番。

definitions_en: n. the system of production and distribution and consumption
n. the efficient use of resources
n. frugality in the expenditure of money or resources
n. an act of economizing; reduction in cost
translations_zh: n. 经济, 理财, 节约
[医] 经济, 整体

examples.en: The economy of the island is dependent on the fishing industry.
examples.zh: 这个岛的经济依靠的是渔业。

examples.en: The town developed into the center of the economy.
examples.zh: 這座城鎮發展成為了一個經濟中心。

definitions_en: a. relating to the study or practice of medicine
a. requiring or amenable to treatment by medicine especially as opposed to surgery
translations_zh: n. 医生, 体格检查
a. 医学的, 内科的, 药的

examples.en: Can I use my medical insurance?
examples.zh: 我可以使用我的醫療保險嗎？

examples.en: Do you have medical insurance?
examples.zh: 你有醫療保險嗎？

definitions_en: n. a health facility where patients receive treatment
n. a medical institution where sick or injured people are given medical or surgical care
translations_zh: n. 医院
[医] 医院

examples.en: The ambulances carried the injured to the nearest hospital.
examples.zh: 救护车把伤者送往了最近的医院。

examples.en: At one time, people would not have hesitated to light up a cigarette in stations, restaurants, or hospital waiting rooms.
examples.zh: 在以前的人的眼中，在車站、餐廳、醫院的等候室裏抽煙並沒有甚麼問題。

definitions_en: n. one of the groups of Christians who have their own beliefs and forms of worship
n. a place for public (especially Christian) worship
n. the body of people who attend or belong to a particular local church
v. perform a special church rite or service for
translations_zh: n. 教堂, 礼拜, 教会
vt. 使人接受宗教仪式
a. 教堂的

examples.en: Even people who don't believe in the Catholic church venerate the Pope as a symbolic leader.
examples.zh: 甚至是不相信天主教的人也把教皇敬为一个象征性的领导者。

examples.en: The old church on the hill dates back to the twelfth century.
examples.zh: 山上的老教堂的歷史可以追溯到12世紀。

definitions_en: n. the cardinal number that is the product of 10 and 100
s. denoting a quantity consisting of 1,000 items or units
translations_zh: num. 千
a. 成千的, 许多的
n. 许许多多

examples.en: If a sick person folds one thousand paper cranes, her wish will come true.
examples.zh: 如果一個病人折一千隻紙鶴, 她的願望就會成真。

examples.en: It cost me ten thousand yen to have my television set repaired.
examples.zh: 把我的電視機修好花了我一萬日元。

definitions_en: n. a flow of electricity through a conductor
n. a steady flow of a fluid (usually from natural causes)
a. occurring in or belonging to the present time
translations_zh: n. 涌流, 趋势, 流
a. 流通的, 现在的, 当前的, 流行的
[计] 当前的

examples.en: We rowed up the river against the current.
examples.zh: 我們在河裏划著船逆流而上。

examples.en: An electric current can generate magnetism.
examples.zh: 電流可以產生磁性。

definitions_en: n. the event of something burning (often destructive)
n. the act of firing weapons or artillery at an enemy
n. the process of combustion of inflammable materials producing heat and light and (often) smoke
n. a fireplace in which a relatively small fire is burning
translations_zh: n. 火, 炉火, 电炉, 火灾, 闪光体, 炮火, 热情
vt. 点燃, 烧制, 使发光, 激动, 放枪, 解雇
vi. 着火, 烧火, 开枪, 射击, 激动

examples.en: Did you hear about the fire yesterday?
examples.zh: 你聽說了昨天的火災嗎?

examples.en: Be sure to put out the fire before you leave.
examples.zh: 一定要熄了火，然后再离开。

definitions_en: n. the time yet to come
n. a verb tense that expresses actions or states in the future
n. bulk commodities bought or sold at an agreed price for delivery at a specified future date
a. yet to be or coming
translations_zh: n. 未来, 将来
a. 将来的, 未来的

examples.en: The past can only be known, not changed. The future can only be changed, not known.
examples.zh: 我們可以回顧過去，但不能改變過去；我們可以改變未來，但不能預知未來。

examples.en: Tell me about your program for the future.
examples.zh: 给我谈谈你未来的计划。

definitions_en: v. connect closely and often incriminatingly
v. engage as a participant
v. contain as a part
v. occupy or engage the interest of
translations_zh: vt. 包括, 使陷于, 潜心于, 包围
[医] 累及, 牵涉, 包含

examples.en: Whichever way we choose will involve danger.
examples.zh: 不管我们选哪条路，都会有危险。

examples.en: Does your family background involve Chinese medicine?
examples.zh: 您的家族史跟中医有没有关系？

definitions_en: n. manner of acting or controlling yourself
n. the action or reaction of something (as a machine or substance) under specified circumstances
n. (psychology) the aggregate of the responses or reactions or movements made by an organism in any situation
translations_zh: n. 行为, 举止
[医] 行为

examples.en: You must put an end to this foolish behavior.
examples.zh: 你该结束这种愚蠢的行为了。

examples.en: Your behavior is creating a lot of problems.
examples.zh: 你的行為引起了許多的麻煩。

definitions_en: n. sloping land (especially the slope beside a body of water)
n. a long ridge or pile
n. an arrangement of similar objects in a row or in tiers
n. a supply or stock held in reserve for future use (especially in emergencies)
translations_zh: n. 银行, 堤, 岸
[医] 库

examples.en: You can get a loan from a bank.
examples.zh: 你可以从银行贷款。

examples.en: You can bank on that.
examples.zh: 你可以相信那個。

definitions_en: n. the countries of (originally) Europe and (now including) North America and South America
n. the cardinal compass point that is a 270 degrees
n. the region of the United States lying to the west of the Mississippi River
n. the direction corresponding to the westward cardinal compass point
translations_zh: n. 西方, 西部
a. 西方的, 向西的
adv. 向西, 自西方, 在西方

examples.en: The island lies to the west of Japan.
examples.zh: 这个岛屿位于日本的西边。

examples.en: The students were for the most part from the West Coast.
examples.zh: 大部分的學生來自西海岸。

definitions_en: n. an active diversion requiring physical exertion and competition
n. the occupation of athletes who compete for pay
n. (Maine colloquial) a temporary summer resident of Maine
n. a person known for the way she (or he) behaves when teased or defeated or subjected to trying circumstances
translations_zh: n. 运动, 游戏, 娱乐, 消遣, 玩笑
a. 运动的, 户外穿戴的
vi. 游戏, 参加体育运动, 戏弄, 产生变种
vt. 炫耀, 使产生变种

examples.en: Boxing is not always a rough sport.
examples.zh: 拳擊並不總是一種粗暴的運動。

examples.en: The point we must clarify here is that the lines between amateur and professional in sport are beginning to disappear.
examples.zh: 我们必须阐明这个观点，在运动项目上，业余选手和专业选手的界限开始消失了。

definitions_en: n. a committee having supervisory powers
n. a stout length of sawn timber; made in a wide variety of sizes and used for many purposes
n. a flat piece of material designed for a special purpose
n. food or meals in general
translations_zh: n. 木板, 甲板, 膳食, 会议桌
vt. 乘船, 供膳食, 用板覆盖
vi. 搭伙
[计] 板

examples.en: Mike is the only man on the board.
examples.zh: Mike是董事会里唯一的男性。

examples.en: Stick a notice on the board.
examples.zh: 把告示貼在在布告板上。

definitions_en: prep. Through; by means of; through the agency of; by; for; for
each; as, per annum; per capita, by heads, or according to individuals;
per curiam, by the court; per se, by itself, of itself. Per is also
sometimes used with English words.
translations_zh: prep. 每一, 通过, 经, 按照
[经] 每, 按照

examples.en: Fifty-two per cent of British women prefer chocolate to sex.
examples.zh: 有百分之五十二的英國女性喜歡巧克力勝於性。

examples.en: In the last typhoon, the wind blew at over 200 kilometers per hour!
examples.zh: 上次颳颱風時，風速超過了 200 公里每小時！

definitions_en: n. the subject matter of a conversation or discussion
n. something (a person or object or scene) selected by an artist or photographer for graphic representation
n. (grammar) one of the two main constituents of a sentence; the grammatical constituent about which something is predicated
n. a person who is subjected to experimental or other observational procedures; someone who is an object of investigation

a. 服从的, 易患...的, 隶属的, 受支配的
adv. 在...条件下
vt. 使隶属, 使受到
[计] 主题, 主体

examples.en: The first subject that attracted my attention was philosophy.
examples.zh: 第一個吸引我注意的科目是哲學。

examples.en: What subject do you like best?
examples.zh: 你最喜歡哪一個科目?

definitions_en: n. a person authorized to serve in a position of authority on a vessel
v. direct or command as an officer
translations_zh: n. 军官, 主管, 官员, 公务员
vt. 指挥

examples.en: The police officer arrested the burglar.
examples.zh: 警官逮捕了竊賊。

examples.en: FSI officer: "Sir, there is a website where ANYONE can add a sentence in a foreign language!". FSI president: "What?! Bomb them!".
examples.zh: FSI人員:"長官，有一個網站，任何人都可以加上一個外國語言的句子!"。FSI主席:"什麼? 炸掉他們!"。

definitions_en: n. an enlisted man of the lowest rank in the Army or Marines
a. confined to particular persons or groups or providing privacy
s. concerning things deeply private and personal
translations_zh: a. 私人的, 秘密的, 私立的, 隐蔽的
n. 士兵, 隐士, 阴部
[计] 私人的

examples.zh: 我想和你單獨談談。

examples.en: Are you a student of a private high school?
examples.zh: 你在私立高中读书吗？

definitions_en: n. a dramatic or musical entertainment
n. the act of presenting a play or a piece of music or other entertainment
n. the act of performing; of doing something successfully; using knowledge as distinguished from merely possessing it
n. any recognized accomplishment
translations_zh: n. 施行, 工作情况, 成绩, 行为, 表现, 演出
[电] 绩效, 性能

examples.zh: 我对我今天的表演不满意。

examples.en: What time is the next performance?
examples.zh: 下一場表演在幾點鐘？

definitions_en: n. the upper part of anything
n. the highest or uppermost side of anything
n. the first half of an inning; while the visiting team is at bat
n. the greatest possible intensity
translations_zh: n. 顶部, 顶端, 极点, 上面, 上部, 顶篷, 最高地位, 首位, 陀螺
a. 最高的, 顶上的, 头等的
vt. 盖, 加以顶, 高达, 超越
vi. 结束, 达到顶点, 高出
[计] TOP协议

examples.en: We gained the top of Mt. Fuji at last.
examples.zh: 我们终于登上了富士山山顶。

examples.en: A car passed by at top speed.
examples.zh: 一辆车全速经过。

definitions_en: n. the state of affairs that a plan is intended to achieve and that (when achieved) terminates behavior intended to achieve it

n. a successful attempt at scoring
translations_zh: n. 目标, 终点, 得分, 球门, 守门员
vi. 攻门, 射门得分

examples.zh: 有了坚定的目标，你会做得很好。

examples.en: My goal in life is to be a novelist.
examples.zh: 我的终生目标是成为一名作家。

definitions_en: n. (often plural) a command given by a superior (e.g., a military or law enforcement officer) that must be obeyed
n. a degree in a continuum of size or quantity
n. established customary state (especially of society)
n. a commercial document used to request someone to supply something in return for payment and providing specifications and quantities
translations_zh: n. 次序, 规则, 命令

n. 顺序, 阶数
[计] 顺序, 阶数

examples.zh: 要这么做，你需要冒险。

examples.en: The British have a lot of respect for law and order.
examples.zh: 英國人很尊重法序和秩序。

definitions_en: v. be the author of
translations_zh: n. 作家, 作家的著作, 创始人
[法] 作者, 著作人, 本人

examples.en: Who is the author of this book?
examples.zh: 這本書的作者是誰?

examples.en: Who is the author of this story?
examples.zh: 这本小说的作者是谁？

definitions_en: v. take the place of or be parallel or equivalent to
v. be representative or typical for

v. be a delegate or spokesperson for; represent somebody's interest or be a proxy or substitute for, as of politicians and office holders representing their constituents, or of a tenant representing other tenants in a housing dispute
v. serve as a means of expressing something
translations_zh: vt. 表现, 表示, 描绘, 讲述, 代表, 象征, 回忆, 再赠送, 再上演

examples.en: The blue lines on the map represent rivers.
examples.zh: 地图上的蓝线代表河流。

examples.en: The red lines on the map represent a railway.
examples.zh: 地圖上的紅線代表鐵路。

definitions_en: n. the concentration of attention or energy on something
n. maximum clarity or distinctness of an image rendered by an optical system
n. maximum clarity or distinctness of an idea
n. a central point or locus of an infection in an organism
translations_zh: n. 焦点, 焦距
vi. 聚焦, 注视
vt. 使聚焦, 调焦, 集中
[计] 焦点

examples.en: These days many young people work without much focus; my friend's son hadn't gone two years after graduating before he'd changed jobs five times.
examples.zh: 现在许多年轻人工作都不太安分，朋友的儿子大学毕业不到两年，已经换了五个工作了。

examples.en: Although people like to focus on the differences, I think that on the whole it's the same.
examples.zh: 虽然人们喜欢集中于不同的方面，但是我认为大部分的差不多。

definitions_en: a. of concern to or concerning the affairs of other nations (other than your own)
a. relating to or originating in or characteristic of another place or part of the world
translations_zh: a. 外国的, 外交的, 外省的, 外来的, 不相关的
[机] 外来的

examples.zh: 外国人很有意思。

examples.en: You seem to be prejudiced against ideas that come from foreign countries.
examples.zh: 你似乎對來自國外的想法有偏見。

definitions_en: n. a shape that is spherical and small
n. a small indefinite quantity (especially of a liquid)
n. a sudden sharp decrease in some quantity
n. a predetermined hiding place for the deposit and distribution of illicit goods (such as drugs or stolen property)
translations_zh: n. 滴, 微量, 落下, 空投
vi. 放下, 掉下, 下降
vt. 使滴下, 放下, 丢失, 遗漏
[计] 投入, 投入点, 接入点, 分接点

examples.en: Please drop in at my house on your way home.
examples.zh: 你回家途中順道來看看我吧。

examples.en: I'll drop you off at the station.
examples.zh: 我載你到車站。

definitions_en: n. the fluid (red in vertebrates) that is pumped through the body by the heart and contains plasma, blood cells, and platelets
n. temperament or disposition
n. people viewed as members of a group
v. smear with blood, as in a hunting initiation rite, where the face of a person is smeared with the blood of the kill
translations_zh: n. 血, 血统, 流血, 气质, 生命
vt. 使出血, 用血涂

examples.en: It made my blood boil to hear that.
examples.zh: 听到这个让我感觉热血沸腾。

examples.en: What's your blood group?
examples.zh: 你的血型是什么？

definitions_en: n. an administrative unit of government
n. a business that serves other businesses
n. the state of being in action or exerting power
translations_zh: n. 代理机构, 经销商, 中介
[化] 办事处

examples.zh: 最近的旅行社在哪裡？

examples.zh: 我們需要人力仲介公司幫我們找到合適的人來擔任這個管理職位。

definitions_en: n. the essential qualities or characteristics by which something is recognized

n. the natural physical world including plants and animals and landscapes etc.
n. the complex of emotional and intellectual attributes that determine a person's characteristic actions and reactions
translations_zh: n. 自然, 大自然, 本性, 性格, 性质
[医] 自然, 大自然; 本性, 性能

examples.en: I am an optimist by nature.
examples.zh: 我天生是一個樂觀主義者。

examples.en: it is his nature to help others

definitions_en: n. a visual attribute of things that results from the light they emit or transmit or reflect
n. interest and variety and intensity
n. the timbre of a musical sound
translations_zh: n. 颜色, 面色, 颜料, 外貌
vt. 把...涂上颜色, 粉饰, 使脸红, 歪曲
vi. 变色

examples.zh: 選你最喜歡的顏色。

examples.en: Gold is similar in color to brass.
examples.zh: 金的顏色和黃銅很相似。

definitions_en: n. a supply of something available for future use

v. find a place for and put away for storage

vt. 储存, 贮藏, 供给
vi. 贮藏
a. 贮藏的, 现成的
[计] 存储器操作; 存储

examples.zh: 请告诉我们哪儿有食品杂货店。

examples.en: This is a store that caters specially to students.
examples.zh: 这是一家专门为学生提供服务的商店。

definitions_en: n. the particular auditory effect produced by a given cause
n. the subjective sensation of hearing something
n. mechanical vibrations transmitted by an elastic medium
n. the sudden occurrence of an audible event
translations_zh: n. 声音, 语音, 吵闹, 声调, 听力范围, 探条, 海峡

adv. 彻底地, 充分地

vt. 使发声, 宣告, 听诊, 测...深, 试探
[计] 声音

examples.zh: 月球表面沒有空氣，所以沒有風，也沒有聲音。

examples.en: The sound of shouting grew faint.
examples.zh: 叫聲漸漸地變弱了。

s. characterized by elegance or refinement or accomplishment

a. 好的, 晴朗的, 健康的, 细小的, 精细的

vi. 变清, 变细
adv. 很好
[计] 精细

examples.zh: 如果明天天氣好，我們就去打棒球。

definitions_en: a. belonging to or participated in by a community as a whole; public
a. having no special distinction or quality; widely known or commonly encountered; average or ordinary or usual
s. common to or shared by two or more parties
s. commonly encountered

examples.en: Music is a common speech for humanity.
examples.zh: 音乐是人类共通的语言。

examples.en: English has now become the common language of several nations in the world.
examples.zh: 英语现已成为世界上许多国家的通用语言了。

definitions_en: n. someone regarded as certain to succeed
n. a notation cancelling a previous sharp or flat
n. (craps) a first roll of 7 or 11 that immediately wins the stake
a. in accordance with nature; relating to or concerning nature
translations_zh: n. 白痴
a. 自然的, 自然界的, 本能的, 天然的, 物质的, 正常的, 原始的, 自然数的

examples.en: It comes natural to him to speak French.
examples.zh: 说法语对他来说很自然。

examples.en: We have consumed all the natural resources.
examples.zh: 我们消耗了所有的自然资源。

definitions_en: n. something that interests you because it is important or affects you
n. an anxious feeling
n. a feeling of sympathy for someone or something
n. something or someone that causes anxiety; a source of unhappiness
translations_zh: n. 关心, 忧虑
vt. 与...有关, 使担心, 使挂念

examples.en: I appreciate your concern.
examples.zh: 我感謝你的關心。

examples.en: My primary concern is your safety.
examples.zh: 我最關心的是你的安全。

definitions_en: n. similar things placed in order or happening one after another
n. a periodical that appears at scheduled times
n. (sports) several contests played successively by the same teams
n. (electronics) connection of components in such a manner that current flows first through one and then through the other
translations_zh: n. 串联, 序列, 连续, 系列, 丛书, 套, 级数, 组
[计] 系列

examples.en: He has just published an interesting series of articles.
examples.zh: 他刚发表一系列有趣的文章。

examples.en: They gave a series of concerts.
examples.zh: 他們辦了一系列的音樂會。

definitions_en: a. important in effect or meaning
s. fairly large
a. too closely correlated to be attributed to chance and therefore indicating a systematic relation
translations_zh: a. 重要的, 有效的, 有含义的, 暗示的, 值得注意的

examples.en: As everyone knows, today is a very significant day for us.
examples.zh: 大家知道，今天对我们来说是一个很有意义的日子。

examples.en: Life is like a marathon, where short-term gains and losses are not significant in and of themselves.
examples.zh: 人生是一次长跑，暂时的落后和领先都不算什么。

definitions_en: a. marked by correspondence or resemblance
s. (of words) expressing closely related meanings
translations_zh: a. 相似的, 类似的
n. 相似的东西

examples.en: Your problem is similar to mine.
examples.zh: 你的問題和我的相似。

examples.en: Your bicycle is similar to mine.
examples.zh: 你的腳踏車和我的很相似。

definitions_en: n. a systematic means of communicating by the use of sounds or conventional symbols
n. the mental faculty or power of vocal communication
translations_zh: n. 语言, 文字, 措辞
[计] 语言

examples.en: It is not easy to learn a foreign language.
examples.zh: 学会一门外语不容易。

examples.en: Learning a foreign language is difficult.
examples.zh: 學習外語是困難的。

definitions_en: n. a result
n. a phrase recited or sung by the congregation following a versicle by the priest or minister
n. the manner in which an electrical or mechanical device responds to an input signal or a range of input signals
translations_zh: n. 反应, 回答, 响应
[计] 应答

examples.en: She made no response to my question.
examples.zh: 她沒有回答我的問題。

examples.en: I'm sorry for the late response.
examples.zh: 我很抱歉回复晚了。

definitions_en: n. a living organism characterized by voluntary movement
s. marked by the appetites and passions of the body
translations_zh: n. 动物
[医] 动物

examples.en: Life in prison is worse than the life of an animal.
examples.zh: 监狱生活比做畜牲还不如。

examples.en: The hunters captured the wild animal with a strong rope net.
examples.zh: 獵人們用堅韌的繩網把野生動物捉住了。

definitions_en: n. anything that contributes causally to a result
n. any of the numbers (or symbols) that form a product when multiplied together
n. an independent variable in statistics
v. resolve into factors
translations_zh: n. 因素, 因数, 系数, 基因, 代理人
[计] 因式

examples.en: When applying to American universities, your TOEFL score is only one factor.
examples.zh: 当您登记美国大学时，您考TOEFL获得的分数只是所选因素的其中一个。

examples.en: Honesty was the most important factor in his success.
examples.zh: 誠實是他成功最重要的因素。

definitions_en: n. a period of 10 years
translations_zh: n. 十年, 十

examples.en: We have experienced many changes over the last decade.
examples.zh: 我们最近十年经历了很多变化。

definitions_en: n broadcasting visual images of stationary or moving objects
n an electronic device that receives television signals and displays them on a screen
translations_zh: 电视
[计] 电视, 转移向量

examples.en: You are always watching TV.
examples.zh: 你總是在看電視。

examples.en: I'm playing a TV game.
examples.zh: 我在玩電視遊樂器。

definitions_en: n. nonfictional prose forming an independent part of a publication
n. one of a class of artifacts
n. a separate section of a legal document (as a statute or contract or will)
n. (grammar) a determiner that may indicate the specificity of reference of a noun phrase
translations_zh: n. 文章, 冠词, 物品, 物件, 条款, 契约
[计] 信件

examples.zh: 抱歉，请允许我指出上文中的三个错误。

examples.en: The news article painted the defendant as a guilty man, even though he had been proven innocent.
examples.zh: 该报文章中将被告人描述成一个罪魁祸首，尽管他已经被证明是无辜的了。

definitions_en: n. the capital raised by a corporation through the issue of shares entitling holders to an ownership interest (equity)
n. the merchandise that a shop has on hand
n. the handle of a handgun or the butt end of a rifle or shotgun or part of the support of a machine gun or artillery gun
n. the reputation and popularity a person has
translations_zh: n. 树干, 祖先, 血统, 原料, 备料, 库存, 牲畜, 股票, 股份, 保留剧目
a. 存货的, 常备的, 平凡的, 普通的, 股票的, 保留剧目的, 繁殖用的
vt. 装把手于, 进货, 备有, 放牧
vi. 出新芽, 备货, 囤积

examples.en: Stock prices plunged to a record low.
examples.zh: 股票價格跌至歷史新低。

examples.en: Stock prices dropped.
examples.zh: 股價下跌了。

definitions_en: n. the particular occupation for which you are trained
n. the general progression of your working or professional life
v. move headlong at high speed
translations_zh: n. 事业, 生涯, 成功
[法] 职业, 专业, 履历

examples.en: She seems to devote all her effects to her career.
examples.zh: 她似乎把自己所有的精力都投入到了事业上。

examples.en: She wants to go to Beijing to further her career.
examples.zh: 她想去北京发展她的事业。

definitions_en: n. a workplace that serves as a telecommunications facility where lines from telephones can be connected together to permit communication
a. in or near a center or constituting a center; the inner area
translations_zh: a. 中央的, 重要的
[医] 中央的, 中心的, 中枢的

examples.en: Which way is Central Park?
examples.zh: 中央公園在哪個方向？

examples.en: What is the central aim of this plan?
examples.zh: 這個計劃的主要目的是甚麼？

definitions_en: n. care provided to improve a situation (especially medical procedures or applications that are intended to relieve illness or injury)
n. the management of someone or something
n. a manner of dealing with something artistically
translations_zh: n. 治疗, 待遇, 处理
[医] 疗法, 治疗; 处理

examples.en: I'm not accustomed to such treatment.
examples.zh: 我不習慣這樣的待遇。

examples.en: You should stay in the hospital for treatment.
examples.zh: 你應該留在醫院，接受治療。

definitions_en: n. ideas or actions intended to deal with a problem or situation
n. the act of drawing spatially closer to something
n. the event of one object coming closer to another
n. the temporal property of becoming nearer in time
translations_zh: n. 接近, 入门
vt. 接近, 近似, 找...商量
vi. 靠近

examples.en: That's the best approach to the study of English.
examples.zh: 那是学英语最好的方法。

examples.en: With the approach of Christmas, business improved somewhat.
examples.zh: 聖誕節快到了，生意也好了點。

definitions_en: n. the physical magnitude of something (how big it is)
n. the property resulting from being one of a series of graduated measurements (as of clothing)
n. any glutinous material used to fill pores in surfaces or to stiffen fabrics
n. the actual state of affairs
translations_zh: n. 大小, 尺寸, 规模, 尺码, 能力, 浆料
vt. 上浆, 依大小排列
vi. 可比拟
a. 一定大小的, 一定尺寸的

examples.en: Your camera is only half the size of mine.
examples.zh: 你的照相機只有我那台的一半大小。

examples.en: What size shoes do you wear?
examples.zh: 你穿幾號的鞋子?

definitions_en: a. concerned with work or important matters rather than play or trivialities
s. of great consequence
s. requiring effort or concentration; complex and not easy to answer or solve
translations_zh: a. 严肃的, 认真的, 重要的, 严重的
[电] 严重的

examples.en: Have you ever had any serious illness?
examples.zh: 你曾经得过重病吗？

examples.en: You have only to read this article to see how serious the accident was.
examples.zh: 你只要讀讀這篇文章，就能知道那意外有多嚴重。

definitions_en: v. come to one's mind; suggest itself
v. to be found to exist
translations_zh: vi. 发生, 被想到, 存在

examples.en: According to some scholars, a major earthquake could occur at any moment now.
examples.zh: 据一些学者称，现在可能随时发生一场特大地震。

examples.en: Bright ideas never occur to me.
examples.zh: 我總想不出什麼好點子。

definitions_en: n a means or instrumentality for storing or communicating information
n the surrounding environment
n an intervening substance through which signals can travel as a means for communication
n (bacteriology) a nutrient substance (solid or liquid) that is used to cultivate micro-organisms
n a liquid with which pigment is mixed by a painter
n (biology) a substance in which specimens are preserved or displayed
n an intervening substance through which something is achieved
n a state that is intermediate between extremes; a middle position
n someone who serves as an intermediary between the living and the dead
n (usually plural) transmissions that are disseminated widely to the public
n an occupation for which you are especially well suited
translations_zh: n. 媒体
[计] 媒质

examples.zh: 我去年得了中耳炎。

examples.zh: 媒體對他所說的話斷章取義並發展到無法控制的地步了。

definitions_en: n. a perceptible indication of something not immediately apparent (as a visible clue that something has happened)
n. a public display of a message
n. (medicine) any objective evidence of the presence of a disorder or disease
n. a gesture that is part of a sign language

vt. 签名, 打手势表达
vi. 签名
[计] 正负号; 符号; 符号字符

examples.en: All you have to do is sign your name here.
examples.zh: 你在這裏簽個名就行了。

examples.en: The rain shows no sign of stopping.
examples.zh: 这雨没有要停的迹象。

definitions_en: n. the organized beliefs of a period or group or individual
translations_zh: n. 想法, 思想, 思维, 关心, 挂念
think的过去式和过去分词

examples.zh: 最后一个听我说我的主意的人认为我疯了。

examples.en: I thought you liked to learn new things.
examples.zh: 我以為你喜歡學習新事物。

vi. 列于表上
[计] 列表, 序列, 数据清单

examples.zh: 我可以看一下酒單嗎？

examples.zh: 把你的名字寫在名單上，然後把名單傳給下一個人。

definitions_en: n. a single organism
a. being or characteristic of a single thing or person

a. 个别的, 个人的, 独特的

examples.zh: 每個人都是不同的。

examples.zh: 个人自由是民主的精髓。

s. unornamented

n. 出身低微者, 傻子

examples.zh: 任何簡單到可以被了解的宇宙便太過簡單而無法產生可以了解它的心靈。

examples.zh: 由於是用簡單的英語所寫的，這本書很容易閱讀。

[计] 品质

examples.zh: 这些年空气质量恶化了。

examples.zh: 一般來說，消费者喜歡數量勝於質量。

examples.zh: 你能檢查一下這個輪胎的氣壓嗎？

examples.zh: 計劃受到輿論的壓力而被取消了。

examples.zh: 唯一比无论什么资源都珍贵的是土地。

examples.en: The only thing that is more precious than any resource is land.
examples.zh: 唯一比什么资源都珍贵的是土地。

definitions_en: v. recognize as being; establish the identity of someone or something
v. consider (oneself) as similar to somebody else
v. conceive of as united or associated
v. identify as in botany or biology, for example
translations_zh: vt. 识别, 认为...等同于, 确定, 使参与

examples.zh: 你可以毫无问题地辨别孩子们的声音。

n. a casual or unexpected convergence
n. the social act of assembling for some common purpose
translations_zh: n. 会议, 会面
[法] 会议, 会谈, 集会

examples.zh: 你在这里是要见谁吧？

examples.en: You should have attended the meeting.
examples.zh: 你應該參加這個會議的。

v. educate for a future role or function
v. lead up to and soften by sounding the dissonant note in it as a consonant note in the preceding chord
translations_zh: vt. 准备, 筹备, 使在思想上有准备, 制造, 调制
vi. 预备

examples.zh: 準備五張明信片大小的硬紙板。

examples.zh: 必須為最壞的情況作好準備。

translations_zh: n. 疾病, 弊病
[医] [疾]病

examples.zh: 最後，他的病奪去了他走路的能力，想去哪兒也要用電動輪椅來代步。

examples.zh: 你也许会染上疾病。

definitions_en: s one or some or every or all without specification

examples.zh: 他跟你说什么，你就做什么。

examples.en: Whatever you said to him made him feel better.
examples.zh: 你對他說的話讓他感覺好多了。

definitions_en: v. present reasons and arguments
v. have an argument about something
v. give evidence of
translations_zh: vi. 提出理由, 争论, 辩论
vt. 主张, 辩论, 证明, 说服

examples.zh: 我們別吵了。

examples.en: Don't argue with an idiot, or else people might not be sure which of you is really the idiot.
examples.zh: 不要同一個傻瓜爭辯、否則別人會搞不清到底誰是傻瓜。

n. the quantity a cup will hold
n. any cup-shaped concavity
n. a United States liquid unit equal to 8 fluid ounces
translations_zh: n. 杯子, 茶杯, 优胜杯
vt. 使成杯状, 为...拔火罐

examples.zh: 桌上有個破杯子。

examples.en: A cup of coffee relieved me of my headache.
examples.zh: 一杯咖啡紓解了我的頭痛。

v. be tantamount or equivalent to

examples.zh: 我們會按照你的工作量付錢給你。

examples.en: A considerable amount of time and effort have been spent already.
examples.zh: 已經花費了很多的時間和精力。

definitions_en: n. the quality of being able to perform; a quality that permits or facilitates achievement or accomplishment
n. possession of the qualities (especially mental qualities) required to do something or get something done
translations_zh: n. 能力, 才干

examples.zh: 某些失明者会产生一个弥补性的能力，这个能力让他们察觉到他们与离他们很近的物体的距离。

examples.zh: 看来他出国学习的目的是要提高他说英语的能力。

n. building material consisting of plaster and hair; used to cover external surfaces of temporary structure (as at an exposition) or for decoration

a. 职员的, 雇员的, 参谋的
vt. 为...配备人员

examples.zh: 在全体职员回家后，火事爆发了。

examples.en: Bill is on the editorial staff.
examples.zh: 比爾在編輯部工作。

definitions_en: n. (biology) the process of an individual organism growing organically; a purely biological unfolding of events involved in an organism changing gradually from a simple to a more complex level

n. vegetation that has grown
n. (pathology) an abnormal proliferation of tissue (as in a tumor)

[计] 等比级数

examples.zh: 更多投資在教育的錢將會刺激經濟成長。

examples.en: The third quarter GNP growth was 1% over the preceding quarter.
examples.zh: 第三季國民生產總值較上一季成長了1％。

definitions_en: n. something that is lost

n. the act of losing someone or something
n. the disadvantage that results from losing something

[化] 损失; 损耗

examples.zh: 我不知道應該說什麼才好。

examples.en: You must make up for the loss.
examples.zh: 您必须弥补损失。

n. a specific identifiable position in a continuum or series or especially in a process
n. a measure for arcs and angles
n. the highest power of a term or variable

[医] 度, 程度

examples.zh: 你喜欢棒球到什么程度？

examples.zh: 我们可以有多相信他？

n. the act of attacking

examples.zh: 翻译跟原文很贴切。

examples.en: He adhered to the original plan.
examples.zh: 他堅持原來的計畫。

definitions_en: n. (biology) taxonomic group whose members can interbreed
n. a specific kind of something
translations_zh: n. 种, 类, 外形
[医] 茶剂; 种

examples.en: Butterflies of this species are now extinct.
examples.zh: 這品種的蝴蝶現在已經絕種了。

examples.en: Gambling site lets users bet on which species will go extinct because of the oil spill in the Gulf of Mexico.
examples.zh: 賭博網站讓用戶投注在將滅絕的物種上，因為墨西哥灣漏油。

definitions_en: n. a pair of parallel rails providing a runway for wheels
n. an endless metal belt on which tracked vehicles move over the ground
n. (computer science) one of the circular magnetic paths on a magnetic disk that serve as a guide for writing and reading data
n. a groove on a phonograph recording
translations_zh: n. 轨迹, 足迹, 径迹, 小道, 轨道, 磁轨, 途径
vt. 循路而行, 追踪, 通过, 用纤拉
vi. 追踪, 留下足迹, 沿轨道运行
[计] 跟踪

examples.en: You're on the right track.
examples.zh: 你的想法是對的。

examples.en: the police are following a promising lead

definitions_en: n. a popular programming language that is relatively easy to learn; an acronym for beginner's all-purpose symbolic instruction code; no longer in general use
n. (usually plural) a necessary commodity for which demand is constant
a. pertaining to or constituting a base or basis
s. reduced to the simplest and most significant form possible without loss of generality
translations_zh: n. 基本原理, 要素, 基本规律
a. 基本的, 碱性的
(计算机)BASIC语言

examples.en: I think your basic theory is wrong.
examples.zh: 我認為你的基本理論是錯的。

examples.en: This law will deprive us of our basic rights.
examples.zh: 这项法律会剥夺我们的基本权利。

definitions_en: n. a group's refusal to work in protest against low pay or bad work conditions
n. an attack that is intended to seize or inflict damage on or destroy an objective
n. a score in tenpins: knocking down all ten with the first ball

n. (baseball) a pitch that the batter swings at and misses, or that the batter hits into foul territory, or that the batter does not swing at but the umpire judges to be in the area over home plate and between the batter's knees and shoulders
translations_zh: n. 罢工, 打击, 殴打
vt. 打, 撞击, 冲击, 侵袭, 取消, 结算, 打掉, 罢工, 刺透, 使生根, 遇见
vi. 打, 打击, 抓, 罢工, 搏动, 触礁, 敲, 响, 穿透, 打动

examples.en: The general strike paralyzed the whole country.
examples.zh: 全面罷工癱瘓了整個國家。

examples.en: The strike affected the nation's economy.
examples.zh: 罢工妨碍了国家经济。

definitions_en: n. the condition of being free; the power to act or speak or think without externally imposed restraints
translations_zh: n. 自由, 坦率, 特权
[法] 自由, 自主, 免除

examples.en: Freedom of speech is now taken as a matter of course.
examples.zh: 現在言論自由被當作是理所當然的事。

examples.en: Freedom of thought is guaranteed by the constitution.
examples.zh: 思想自由為憲法所保障。

definitions_en: v. to gain with effort
translations_zh: vt. 完成, 达到
vi. 如愿以偿

examples.en: You'll never achieve anything if you don't study harder.
examples.zh: 如果你不更加努力地學習, 你將永遠不會有所成就。

examples.en: That's the true genius of America; that America can change. Our Union can be perfected. What we've already achieved gives us hope for what we can and must achieve tomorrow.
examples.zh: 这才是美国真正的精华——美国能够改变。我们的联邦会日渐完美。我们现在已取得的成就为我们将来能够取得和必须取得的成就增添了希望。

definitions_en: n. a tangible and visible entity; an entity that can cast a shadow
n. (grammar) a constituent that is acted upon
n. the focus of cognitions or feelings
n. (computing) a discrete item that provides a description of virtually anything known to a computer
translations_zh: n. 物体, 目标, 目的, 对象, 宾语, 客体
vi. 反对, 抱反感
vt. 提出...来反对
[计] 对象

examples.en: I don't object to your going out to work, but who will look after the children?
examples.zh: 我并不反对你出去工作，可是小孩靠谁来照看呢？

examples.en: The surface of the object is fairly rough.
examples.zh: 這件物件的表面頗為粗糙。

definitions_en: n. a person who seeks the advice of a lawyer
translations_zh: n. 客户, 顾客, 委托人
[计] 客户, 客户机, 客户机程序

examples.en: The lawyer warned his client against testifying, but he did it anyway.
examples.zh: 律師警告過他的當事人反對作證, 但是他還是這麼做了。

examples.en: The investor stole the capital of his client.
examples.zh: 投资者把他客户的资金窃取了.

definitions_en: v. make perfect or complete
a. being complete of its kind and without defect or blemish
s. precisely accurate or exact
translations_zh: n. 完成时
a. 完美的, 完好的, 理想的, 熟练的, 精确的, 完成式的
vt. 使完美, 修改, 使精通, 改善, 使熟练

examples.en: To be perfect she lacked just one defect.
examples.zh: 要变得完美，她就是少了一个缺点。

examples.en: You've done a perfect job.
examples.zh: 你做了一项完美的工作。

definitions_en: n. the use of speech for informal exchange of views or ideas or information etc.
translations_zh: n. 会话, 说话, 交谈
[法] 交谈, 社交, 性交

examples.en: The professor teaches English conversation.
examples.zh: 教授他教英語會話。

examples.en: An old man broke into our conversation.
examples.zh: 一位老人打斷了我們的談話。

definitions_en: v. be present at (meetings, church services, university), etc.
v. take charge of or deal with
v. to accompany as a circumstance or follow as a result
v. give heed (to)
translations_zh: vt. 参加, 照料, 伴随
vi. 专心于, 照顾, 服侍, 出席

examples.en: Where do you attend high school?
examples.zh: 你在哪裡唸高中?

examples.en: Are you going to attend the meeting?
examples.zh: 你要參加會議嗎？

definitions_en: n. (biology) a taxonomic category consisting of members of a species that differ from others of the same species in minor but heritable characteristics
n. a difference that is usually pleasant
translations_zh: n. 多样, 种类, 变种, 杂耍
[化] 变种

examples.en: The explanation below was achieved by comparing and contrasting a variety of different theories.
examples.zh: 下面的解釋是通過比較和對比各種不同的理論。

examples.en: There was a great variety of dishes on the menu.
examples.zh: 菜單上有各種各樣的菜色。

definitions_en: n. a natural and periodic state of rest during which consciousness of the world is suspended
n. a torpid state resembling deep sleep
n. a period of time spent sleeping
v. be asleep
translations_zh: n. 睡眠, 静止, 昏迷, 麻木, 长眠, 冬眠
vi. 睡觉, 睡眠, 静止
vt. 睡

examples.en: I have to go to sleep.
examples.zh: 我该去睡觉了。

examples.en: You should sleep.
examples.zh: 你應該去睡覺了吧。

definitions_en: n. the work of inquiring into something thoroughly and systematically
translations_zh: n. 调查, 审查
[医] 调查, 调查研究

examples.en: The investigation is under way.
examples.zh: 相關調查正在進行中。

examples.en: It is clearly shown in Johnson's investigation that passive smoking is very harmful.
examples.zh: 在Johnson的调查里，明确地证明了二手烟是很有害的。

definitions_en: n. an open clash between two opposing groups (or individuals)
n. opposition between two simultaneous but incompatible feelings
n. a state of opposition between persons or ideas or interests
n. an incompatibility of dates or events
translations_zh: n. 战斗, 冲突, 矛盾, 争执
vi. 争执, 战斗, 冲突, 抵触
[计] 冲突

examples.en: The conflict between blacks and whites in the city became worse.
examples.zh: 在这个城市，白人和黑人间的争端愈演愈烈。

examples.en: He seems not to be aware of the conflict between my father and me.
examples.zh: 他似乎不知道我父亲和我之间的纠葛。

definitions_en: n. the people of Great Britain
a. of or relating to or characteristic of Great Britain or its people or culture
translations_zh: a. 英国的
n. 英国人, 英国英语

examples.en: Fifty-two per cent of British women prefer chocolate to sex.
examples.zh: 有百分之五十二的英國女性喜歡巧克力勝於性。

examples.en: The British have a lot of respect for law and order.
examples.zh: 英國人很尊重法序和秩序。

definitions_en: n. a fact or assertion offered as evidence that something is true
n. a discussion in which reasons are advanced for and against some proposition or proposal
n. a summary of the subject or plot of a literary work or play or movie
n. (computer science) a reference or value that is passed to a function, procedure, subroutine, command, or program
translations_zh: n. 争论, 论证, 论据, 自变量
[计] 参数

examples.en: My comment sparked off an argument in the group.
examples.zh: 我的評論引起了小組內的爭論。

examples.en: I tried very hard to put an end to their heated argument.
examples.zh: 我努力地平息他們不斷加溫的爭執。

definitions_en: n. temporary living quarters specially built by the army for soldiers
n. a group of people living together in a camp
n. temporary lodgings in the country for travelers or vacationers
n. a penal institution (often for forced labor)
translations_zh: n. 露营, 帐篷
vi. 露营, 扎营
vt. 使扎营

examples.en: We found it very hard going back to our base camp in the blizzard.
examples.zh: 暴风雪使得我们难以返回营地。

examples.en: A small rock was thrown into our camp.
examples.zh: 小石頭被丟到我們營地。

definitions_en: n. a prominent attribute or aspect of something
n. the characteristic parts of a person's face: eyes and nose and mouth and chin
n. the principal (full-length) film in a program at a movie theater
n. a special or prominent article in a newspaper or magazine
translations_zh: n. 面孔的一部分(如眼、口等), 特征, 容貌, 特色, 特写
vt. 是...的特色, 特写, 放映
vi. 起重要作用
[计] 特性

examples.en: It's not a bug, it's an undocumented feature.
examples.zh: 这不是一个漏洞，而是一个没有写进文档的特性。

examples.en: The audio feature is only available in some sentences in Chinese, Dutch, French, German and Shanghainese.
examples.zh: 音頻功能僅適用在某些語言的句子中，如中文，荷蘭語，法語，德語和上海話。

definitions_en: n. a time period usually extending from Friday night through Sunday; more loosely defined as any period of successive days including one and only one Sunday
v. spend the weekend
translations_zh: n. 周末, 周末休假

examples.en: She got sick this weekend.
examples.zh: 她周末病倒了。

examples.en: It is out of the question for you to go to New York this weekend.
examples.zh: 這個週末去紐約對你來說是不可能的事。

definitions_en: n. promise of reimbursement in the case of loss; paid to people or companies so concerned about hazards that they have made prepayments to an insurance company
translations_zh: n. 保险, 保险业, 保险费
[医] 保险

examples.en: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.
examples.zh: 万一船运迟了，我们有特别的迟到保险。

examples.en: Can I use my medical insurance?
examples.zh: 我可以使用我的醫療保險嗎？

definitions_en: n. a specialized division of a large organization
n. the territorial and administrative division of some countries (such as France)
n. a specialized sphere of knowledge
translations_zh: n. 部门, 系, 机关
[医] 部, 科

examples.en: There is a bookstore in front of the department store.
examples.zh: 百货商店前有个书店。

examples.en: Kelly carries the news department.
examples.zh: 凱利主持新聞部門。

definitions_en: n. the event consisting of the start of something
n. the time at which something is supposed to begin
n. the first part or section of something
n. the place where something begins, where it springs into being
translations_zh: n. 开始

examples.en: When you're beginning to look like the photo in your passport, you should go on a holiday.
examples.zh: 当我们开始像自己护照上的照片时，我们该去度假了。

examples.en: Tell us the story from beginning to end.
examples.zh: 請你把故事從頭到尾給我們說一遍。

definitions_en: n. the specified day of the month
n. a participant in a date
n. a meeting arranged in advance
n. a particular but unspecified point in time
translations_zh: n. 日期, 约会, 枣椰树
vt. 约会, 定日期
vi. 注明日期, 过时

examples.en: Mick killed time by reading a magazine while waiting for his date.
examples.zh: Mick等待约会的时候靠读杂志打发时间。

examples.en: Michael, this is the restaurant where your father and I had our first date.
examples.zh: 麥可, 這家餐廳就是你爸爸和我第一次約會的地方。

definitions_en: n. a native or inhabitant of Africa
a. of or relating to the nations of Africa or their peoples
translations_zh: n. 非洲人
a. 非洲的, 非洲人的

examples.en: The African ground squirrels collaborate and are not aggressive to other mammals.
examples.zh: 非洲地松鼠互帮互助，对其他哺乳动物没有攻击性。

examples.en: A gritty story of redemption and hope in a ramshackle urban township is the South African entry for this year's Academy Awards and one of the five finalists for Best Foreign Language Film.
examples.zh: 这部发生在破旧不堪小镇的救赎与希望之歌，是南非选送今年奥斯卡的作品，并入围了最佳外语片五强角逐。

definitions_en: n. an unstable situation of extreme danger or difficulty
n. a crucial stage or turning point in the course of something
translations_zh: n. 危机, 危险期, 紧要关头
[医] 危象; 骤退, 临界, 极期

examples.en: In a crisis, you must get in touch with your teacher.
examples.zh: 在危險的時候你必須跟你的老師聯繫。

examples.en: Let us remember that if this financial crisis taught us anything, it's that we cannot have a thriving Wall Street while Main Street suffers.
examples.zh: 让我们记住这一点，如果说这场金融危机教会了我们什么东西的话，那就是我们不可能在金融以外的领域处于困境的同时拥有繁荣兴旺的华尔街。

definitions_en: v. come or bring to a finish or an end; others finished in over 4 hours"
v. bring to a whole, with all the necessary parts or elements
v. complete a pass
v. write all the required information onto a form
translations_zh: a. 完全的, 十足的, 完成的
vt. 完成, 完工, 使圆满

examples.en: The project was a complete failure.
examples.zh: 這個計劃徹底的失敗了。

examples.en: This book contains the complete works of Shakespeare.
examples.zh: 這本書是莎士比亞的作品全集。

definitions_en: n. an implement consisting of a length of wood
n. a small thin branch of a tree
n. a lever used by a pilot to control the ailerons and elevators of an airplane
n. a rectangular quarter pound block of butter or margarine
translations_zh: n. 棍, 棒, 刺, 枯枝, 茎, 条状物
vt. 插进, 刺入, 钉住, 伸出, 粘贴, 停止
vi. 粘住, 停留, 坚持, 陷住, 伸出

examples.en: Stick a notice on the board.
examples.zh: 把告示貼在在布告板上。

examples.en: I think you had better stick to your present job.
examples.zh: 我覺得你應該繼續做這份工作。

definitions_en: n. the relative position or standing of things or especially persons in a society
translations_zh: n. 状态, 情形, 地位, 要人身份
[计] 状态

examples.en: Citizens of higher social status were permitted to live closer to the center.
examples.zh: 社會地位較高的公民被允許住在較靠近市中心的地方。

examples.en: Obviously, they are jealous of his wealth and status.
examples.zh: 他们很明显在嫉妒他的财富和地位。

definitions_en: a. conforming with or constituting a norm or standard or level or type or social norm; not abnormal
a. in accordance with scientific laws
a. being approximately average or within certain limits in e.g. intelligence and development
s. forming a right angle
translations_zh: n. 常态, 标准, 正常, 普通
a. 正常的, 正规的, 标准的, 师范的, 正态的
[计] 标准, 普通

examples.en: Stop seeing me as a "normal" person!
examples.zh: 不要再把我当成“正常”人！

examples.en: After a six month period, his leg was healed and is normal again.
examples.zh: 過了六個月，他的腿便治好，回復正常了。

definitions_en: n. any of the Sino-Tibetan languages spoken in China; regarded as dialects of a single language (even though they are mutually unintelligible) because they share an ideographic writing system
n. a native or inhabitant of Communist China or of Nationalist China
a. of or pertaining to China or its peoples or cultures
translations_zh: n. 中文, 中国话, 中国人
a. 中国的, 中国话的

examples.en: I started learning Chinese last week.
examples.zh: 我上周开始学中文了。

examples.en: Have you ever read any Chinese poems?
examples.zh: 你讀過任何一首中國詩詞嗎?

definitions_en: n. a vessel that carries passengers or freight
v. hire for work on a ship
v. travel by ship
v. place on board a ship
translations_zh: n. 船, 舰
vt. 以船运送, 装船, 运送
vi. 上船, 乘船

examples.en: Which goes faster, a ship or a train?
examples.zh: 船和火车哪个跑得快？

examples.en: A camel is, so to speak, a ship on the desert.
examples.zh: 骆驼，这么说吧，也就是沙漠中的船。

definitions_en: n. building material consisting of a piece of rock hewn in a definite shape for a special purpose
n. an avoirdupois unit used to measure the weight of a human body; equal to 14 pounds
n. the hard inner (usually woody) layer of the pericarp of some fruits (as peaches or plums or cherries or olives) that contains the seed
n. United States jurist who was named chief justice of the United States Supreme Court in 1941 by Franklin D. Roosevelt (1872-1946)
translations_zh: n. 石头, 宝石, 果核, 纪念碑, 结石
vt. 投扔石子, 铺石头
a. 石的, 石制的, 完全的

examples.en: To kill two birds with one stone.
examples.zh: 一石二鸟。

examples.en: Can you lift this stone?
examples.zh: 你能舉起這塊石頭嗎？

definitions_en: n. a homogeneous mixture of two or more substances; frequently (but not necessarily) a liquid solution
n. a statement that solves a problem or explains how to solve the problem
n. a method for solving a problem
n. the set of values that give a true statement when substituted into an equation
translations_zh: n. 解决, 解答, 溶液
[化] 溶液

examples.en: If there's no solution, then there's no problem.
examples.zh: 如果没有解决方法，那就没有问题。

examples.en: the solution took three hours

definitions_en: n. an ordered reference standard
n. relative magnitude
n. the ratio between the size of something and a representation of it
n. a specialized leaf or bract that protects a bud or catkin
translations_zh: n. 刻度, 衡量, 比例, 比例尺, 数值范围, 等级, 规模, 天平, 秤, 鳞, 积垢
vt. 依比例决定, 攀登, 测量, 绘制, 刮鳞, 使生垢, 过秤
vi. 剥落, 生水垢, 重量为, 攀登, 衡量
[计] 刻度

examples.en: Please put your baggage on this scale.
examples.zh: 请把你的行李放在这秤上。

examples.en: I want a map of Texas on a scale of 1 to 250000.
examples.zh: 我想要一张1比250000的得克萨斯州的地图。

definitions_en: n. the operator of a motor vehicle
n. someone who drives animals that pull a vehicle
n. a golfer who hits the golf ball with a driver
n. (computer science) a program that determines how a computer will communicate with a peripheral device
translations_zh: n. 驾驶员, 驱动器, 驱动程序
[化] 驱动器

examples.en: The driver increased his speed.
examples.zh: 司機加了速。

examples.en: He managed to pass his driving test even though he was a poor driver.
examples.zh: 他的駕駛技術很差，但也勉強通過了駕駛考試。

definitions_en: n. earnest and conscientious activity intended to do or accomplish something
translations_zh: n. 尝试, 企图
vt. 尝试, 企图

examples.en: His attempt to escape was successful.
examples.zh: 他嘗試逃走而成功了。

examples.en: More recently, some hutongs have been designated as protected areas in an attempt to preserve this aspect of Chinese cultural history.
examples.zh: 最近，有些胡同被指定为保护区，以试图保存这方面的中国文化历史。

definitions_en: n. a short section or illustration (as between radio or tv programs or in a magazine) that is often used for advertising
n. a small contrasting part of something
n. a section of an entertainment that is assigned to a specific performer or performance
n. a business establishment for entertainment
translations_zh: n. 污点, 地点, 斑点, 点, 娱乐场所, 处境, 少量
a. 当场的, 现场的, 现货买卖的, 现金交易的, 抽样的
vt. 点缀, 玷污, 认出, 准确定...的位, 用灯光照射
vi. 玷污, (从空中)侦察敌方目标

examples.en: The lake is deepest at this spot.
examples.zh: 这里是湖最深的地方。

examples.en: There were ten police officers on the spot.
examples.zh: 现场有10名警员。

definitions_en: n. the state of needing something that is absent or unavailable
translations_zh: n. 缺乏, 无, 不足
vt. 缺乏, 短少, 不足, 需要
vi. 缺乏

examples.en: The firm went under due to lack of capital.
examples.zh: 公司由于缺乏资本倒闭了。

examples.en: We failed due to a lack of preparation.
examples.zh: 我們因缺乏準備而失敗了。

definitions_en: n. water frozen in the solid state
n. the frozen part of a body of water
n. diamonds
n. a frozen dessert with fruit flavoring (especially one containing no milk)
